description: The older way to connect, for a machine where the install tool cannot set up the helper: writes the port and token the Page Scanner extension needs, and returns them so you can tell the user what to paste. Prefer install. The token is a secret that lets anything holding it scan any tab the user has open, and it will appear in this conversation, so do not repeat it anywhere else.

rotate.description: Issue a new token, invalidating the old one. Every browser must be re-paired.

name: pair
title: Pair this machine with Chrome
